title: Our Favorite Most Amazing Guacamole
description: This simple homemade guacamole recipe is great for weeknight dinners with tacos, burritos, or quesadillas--or serve it at your next party with a big bowl of tortilla chips.
ingredients: 3 ripe avocados - halved, pitted, and peeled
2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, or to taste
1 clove garlic, minced, or to taste
0.25 teaspoon kosher salt, or to taste
1 pinch ground multi-colored peppercorns, or to taste

steps.text: Place avocados in a medium bowl and squeeze in lime juice. Add tomatoes, shallot, cilantro, garlic, salt, and pepper. Mash with an immersion blender or a sturdy fork until avocado is mashed and ingredients are combined. Stir gently and serve immediately.
